full_judgment: 42. In the instant case before us statements of 3 witnesses namely Bazlu, Shahjahan and Mahbub Gazi were recorded by a competent Magistrate under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure. But they were not examined by the prosecution during the course of trial. A single sentence statement was, however, made by PW.1 Mokbul Gazi in his examination-in-chief that Bazlu, Mahbub and Shajahan were gained over by the defence. But this was not sufficient to prevent the prosecution agency from producing the said 3 witnesses before the tribunal below. If they resiled from the statements made by them under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure prosecution could have contradicted them to impeach their credit in terms of provision of section 155 of the Evidence Act. At any rate they should not have been withheld. It thus raised a presumption under section 114 (g) of the Evidence Act to the effect that had they been produced they would not have supported the case of the prosecution. Of course the instant 4 condemned prisoners were absconding from the very beginning but ascension itself could not be a ground for conviction when there was lack of sufficient evidence against them.
